name: The Breaker (class portrait)
paint: A heavy-shouldered fighter mid-stride, holding one conventional single-bit axe upright beside the body, grinning toward the next obstacle.
avoid: a barbarian from a known work · bare-chested pin-up pose
section: Raw Power: the Momentum chain, and the Breaker
prompt:
Create a COMPLETELY NEW original Project Heaven Cry BREAKER class portrait FROM SCRATCH. New person, new pose, new layout. Vertical 4:5 full-bleed opaque painted illustration, waist-up. A broad heavy-shouldered fighter in a worn charcoal-and-olive padded work coat strides toward the viewer-right with a confident crooked grin. Mature medium-brown face, strong square jaw, short cropped black hair, short dark beard, believable human proportions. One small burnt-orange cloth accent. Dusty workshop archway and broken plaster in the quiet background, warm daylight on one side.
SIMPLE PHYSICALLY CLEAR EQUIPMENT POSE: he holds ONE ORDINARY SINGLE-BIT AXE UPRIGHT BESIDE HIS BODY on the viewer-LEFT. It is NOT on his shoulder. The straight wooden haft is nearly VERTICAL and stays OUTSIDE the body silhouette. His RIGHT HAND, down near waist height, clearly wraps around the same ONE shaft with a natural straight wrist. The haft continues uninterrupted UP from that hand into the EYE/SOCKET of ONE compact iron axe head, well above the hand and entirely visible. The axe head has ONE broad cutting blade extending LEFT of the vertical shaft and only a short blunt flat poll to the RIGHT. A small wood wedge secures the top of the shaft in the eye. Mechanically conventional simple axe, no double head, X, crossed bars, second shaft, floating blade or elaborate fantasy cutouts. Entire head and grip stay away from the face and coat, with clear empty background between axe and torso. His other arm swings naturally as he walks. Nobody is being attacked; no injury or combat scene.
HEAVENPRINT rendering: traditional-looking opaque GOUACHE AND INK, angular directional brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry-brush scumbling, warm ivory edge accents, deep charcoal lost edges, matte iron and visible wood grain. Lived-in science-fantasy workwear, restrained believable face stylization, expressive eyes, quiet low-detail background. Not photography, photoreal skin, 3D render, glossy concept art, flat vector art or exaggerated anime. Eye line about22% from top; face and decisive gripping hand clearly in the central80%. Chest/waist framing with enough room for the complete axe head, single continuous shaft and grip. No text, lettering, labels, logos, real uniform/faith insignia, graphic emblems, frame, border or watermark.
brief_paint_original: A heavy-shouldered fighter mid-stride with a war axe resting on one shoulder, dust kicked up, grinning at the next wall to go through.
composition_scope: new original waist-up Heavenprint portrait; no previous portrait used
user_revision: Remake the whole image from scratch; choose a physically clear upright axe carry instead of the rejected shoulder pose.
export_processing: Centered aspect-preserving 4:5 crop and Lanczos downsample to RGB portrait
mechanical_review: Fresh composition: one upright continuous wooden haft visibly passes through a single axe-head socket and the gripping hand; one cutting bit, no crossed head/haft, no shoulder support claim.
